name: MiniKanban
description: A small project-management / kanban-board tool for Drupal (cards, columns, comments).
project_description:
This is a lightweight Kanban board for smaller teams, that wants full control over their project management software or that want the project management software to run on the website that it is managing.

 Since its using custom entities for everything, it is very easy to extend it with more complex features, like Slack notifications, Github integrations etc for anyone wanting to do that.

 The module was made to be a vehicle to keep state for the agents of the AI Interpolator module (coming soon). While the agents are pretty experimental, the Kanban board itself is not and can be used for smaller projects.

 Features 
 
 Projects 
 Projects per user 
 Epics 
 Tasks 
 File Uploads 
 User tagging 
 Mail Notifications 
 
 Installation 
 
 Install the module like any other. 
 Visit /admin/config/workflow/minikanban to configure it. 
 Visit /kanban to use it. 
 Back to top
